gloss: as much as one wants, unlimited

definitions.gloss: as much as one wants, all-you-can, unlimited
definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to verb stems to indicate doing something without limit or restriction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{放題|ほうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to an all-you-can-eat restaurant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{放題|ほうだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二時間|にじかん}→二時間：27637_nijikan⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

notes:
FORMATION: Verb stem + {放題|ほうだい}

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{放題|ほうだい} (all-you-can-eat)
- ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{放題|ほうだい} (all-you-can-drink)
- ⟦{使|つか}い→使う：00473_tsukau⟧{放題|ほうだい} (unlimited use)
- ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧{放題|ほうだい} (watch as much as you want)
- ⟦{歌|うた}い→歌う：00684_utau⟧{放題|ほうだい} (sing as much as you want - karaoke)

NUANCE: When describing someone's behavior (like ⟦{言|い}い→言う：00515_iu⟧{放題|ほうだい}), it often carries a negative connotation of being unrestrained or inconsiderate.

CULTURAL NOTE: ⟦{食|た}べ→食べる：00396_taberu⟧{放題|ほうだい} and ⟦{飲|の}み→飲む：00322_nomu⟧{放題|ほうだい} are extremely popular in Japan, especially at izakaya (⟦{居酒屋|いざかや}→居酒屋：09635_izakaya⟧) and buffet restaurants.
